body: Practical read: huwag mag-panic-buy ng fuel dahil lang sa oil spike. Mas sensible ang household defense ay iwasang magdagdag ng malaking variable-rate debt habang sabay na mataas ang JGB yields, oil at mahina ang yen. Kung may major car loan o mortgage decision ngayong buwan, stress-test muna ang budget sa mas mataas na monthly payment at fuel/utility costs. The article itself says the regime is still conditional, so protection beats prediction.

claims.text: Avoiding new large variable-rate debt is a proportionate household response while Japanese yields, oil and yen-related import pressure are simultaneously elevated.
claims.basis: Practical inference from the target article's established bond, oil and FX conditions.
